notes.title: Announcing Island Cities (+ Our next games)
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/54142ae676dabc8990a2085a61f7a66edc7b67e7.jpg[/img]

Hi, folks!

[u][b]Island Cities[/b][/u] is the game we are releasing next. 🏣🏬

Cities are usually concrete jungles, noisy and stressful.
But you can also entertain yourself by looking at how they are organized, finding interesting details, and seeing life unfold. Then you can see that they are also vibrant and full of life.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/21c591bec4d698eb6a7a3a9f0344e1f32a2fa104.gif[/img]

Carefully observe the island, try to memorize it, then shuffle the blocks. Swap blocks to reproduce the desired island and the city will emerge.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/2878dba47a92b99123028c9889b15f681eca17b0.gif[/img]

If you enjoyed playing Island Farmer, we think you'll enjoy Island Cities. Add it to your wishlist and follow the game so you don't miss the release discount!
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/ae4d4069493189bf3d335bc6418e270ec32ebd15.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2093900/Island_Cities__Jigsaw_Puzzle/

These are our other games in development - follow them too!

notes.title: Island Farmer is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/344c38eb4bc78bc1ddf48368fa86f55d7ba57f8f.jpg[/img]

Farms are set up in islands over calm and clear water.
In this tiny fantasy experience, that is easy to do and very relaxing, just like a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

Swap the blocks to recreate the desired island and it will compose the archipelago.

There is no time limit, logic challenges, or resources to manage, so you can calmly just focus on the core mechanics while listening to a soothing soundtrack.
[list]
[*] Click on two blocks to swap them,
[*] Turn the camera around the island;
[*] Zoom in and out to see details or the big picture;
[*] Preview the expected arrangement.
[/list]
As you progress building the islands, see your archipelago expand and evolve in the background.
With clear skies, fresh air, and crystal clear water, among animals and listening to the sounds of nature.


Play it now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1564560/Island_Farmer__Jigsaw_Puzzle/

Follow us on Steam and keep up-to-date with our releases!

notes.title: Pathfinders: Memories - Full version released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614392/f7349379270a52ec7d8c29a72d348bb8442a7fd1.jpg[/img]

Pathfinders: Memories has just been released in Full Version!

Use your memory to help Pathfinders travel through time visiting ancient human civilizations and search for relics. The path to success is full of entrapments, obstacles, and enemies. Memorize them and draw the safe path for our heroes.

The final version adds these features:

- The final civilization - England in Industrial Revolution - is available, completing the total of six civilizations - Ancient Rome, Ancient Egypt, the Vikings, Mali Empire, the Arabs, and Industial England.

- The museum of the human civilizations - the gallery showcasing the relics found in each civilization can be visited at any time. Find all of them to complete the museum!

Play it now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294780/Pathfinders_Memories/


We thank everyone who supported us during Early Access by playing the game.

We are a small game studio focused on creating games that are simple but provide a pleasant experience to the player, mostly solving puzzles (either logic, word, jigsaw) in a relaxing environment, without timers or rush.

Follow our studio page on Steam to keep up-to-date with our releases!

notes.title: Mini Tone Update!
notes.content:
Hi, folks! 
Thank you for playing [b]Mini Tone[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35325317/9e8964226d87b07ef673d10c6bf93504d6a88083.png[/img]

Based on your feedback we've released an update with new features.
They include:
[list]
[*] a marker on previous throw position, so that player can plan next throw based on that;
[*] tips for the player - if you get stuck in a level, tips will be offered;
[*] improved color palette change, with a reset to default palette option;
[*] some balancing on level progression.
[/list]
And, in further updates, expect new levels and achievements!
We hope you enjoy it! 

Leave your review on the store, that motivates and helps us to keep improving the game.
